symptom: After `alter menu M.Menu { insert … }`, a describe -> `create or modify menu` of the unchanged menu reported "Modified menu M.Menu" (a second round trip then said Unchanged); a fresh `create menu` round-tripped Unchanged. `set ( Icon: … ) on <item>` on an item `create menu` wrote failed with "menu item <id> has no Icon property".
cause: `create menu` encodes items through the codec, which drops a null element property unless the type registers it; Menus$MenuItem registered only AlternativeText, so an iconless item had no Icon key, where every Studio Pro item (and every item the navigation writer and the ALTER splice build) carries Icon: null. Two writers of the same element disagreed on its property set.
file: `mdl/backend/modelsdk/menu_write.go` (init: codec.RegisterTypeDefaults("Menus$MenuItem", NullFields AlternativeText + Icon)); `mdl/backend/menumutator/mutator.go` setItemField inserts a missing key in Studio Pro's alphabetical order instead of failing
insight: When two write paths build the same $Type (here the codec's create menu and the hand-built navMenuItemBson the splice reuses), compare their key sets on one document: the disagreement surfaces only when both write into it, as a describe -> exec that is not a fixed point. A splice that sets a property must not assume the key exists — data written by an older or different writer may lack it. Measured with real mx check 11.6.6: 0 errors before and after; the only symptom is the Modified/Unchanged report and the CLAUDE.md rule-4 property set.
